figures.finding: Jamaica's first actors' union, the Jamaica Actors Guild Association (JAGA), was launched in Kingston on 30 July 2026 to negotiate fair pay and working conditions; anyone Jamaican or of Jamaican heritage may join, across theatre, film, television and digital media.

value.joining: open to all persons who are Jamaican or of Jamaican heritage

figures.applies: Jamaica from 30 July 2026; no dues, joining procedure or agreement published in the reports.

sources.said: the Jamaica Actors Guild Association (JAGA) was officially launched last week at the Canopy Courtyard in St Andrew. It is the first union of its kind in Jamaica dedicated exclusively to representing and protecting the island’s actors. … All persons who are Jamaican or of Jamaican heritage are welcome to join JAGA.

The association was officially launched on July 30 during a ceremony at Circle the Date in Kingston. … foster greater collaboration across Jamaica’s film, television, theatre, and digital media industries.

figures.finding: No agreement sets a Jamaican actor's pay: the actors' union founded in July 2026 says actors have had no standard contract terms, no cap on hours and no collective mechanism to negotiate pay.
figures.applies: Jamaica as of the union's launch (July 2026); JAGA had concluded no agreement by the reports.

sources.said: without a union, Jamaican actors have had no standard contract terms, no guaranteed meal breaks or rest periods, no enforced cap on working hours, no formal grievance process, and no collective mechanism to negotiate pay.

sources.title: The Gleaner, «Jamaica launches first actors’ union», 4 August 2026 (the paper's report of the launch and of the union officers' words; no JAGA website found)
